description:
Role Description

We are looking for a knowledgeable and detail-oriented Windows System Admin with strong expertise in Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM), workstation image creation, application packaging, and patch management. In this role, you will ensure the efficient deployment and maintenance of workstation environments across the organization while maintaining compliance with internal IT standards.

Location: Grozăvești, Bucharest
Work Setup: Hybrid

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain Active Directory infrastructure, including user and group management and GPOs.
  • Manage DNS and DHCP services for reliable name resolution and IP address management.
  • Manage and maintain Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM) infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain standard workstation images and deploy software packages and updates using SCCM.
  • Perform patch management and ensure compliance with security and operational policies (including CIS baseline).
  • Implement and maintain Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) for secure authentication and communications.
  • Troubleshoot deployment, configuration, and infrastructure issues, ensuring system stability and performance.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Proven experience with Microsoft SCCM (Endpoint Configuration Manager).
  • Proven experience in system administration with a focus on Active Directory, DNS, DHCP and PKI.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows OS deployment and imaging.
  • Experience in application packaging and deployment.
  • Understanding of patch management processes.
  • Basic scripting skills (PowerShell preferred).
  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., MCSA, Modern Desktop Administrator Associate) - nice to have


Employer’s Offer

  • Net salary: up to 9000 RON
  • Meal tickets
  • Medical subscription.
